title: Full Al-Qiyamah: madd 'iwad and the stops: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Full Al-Qiyamah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 30. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ (٣١) وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ (٣٢) ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ (٣٣) أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ (٣٤) ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ (٣٥) أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى (٣٦) أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ (٣٧) ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ (٣٨) فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ (٣٩) أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ (٤٠)

keywords.def: an alif in place of tanween fathah at a stop: 2 counts
the last word of an ayah
stopping on a word, with a breath

questions.q: Stop map (pupil PDF): write how to stop on every ayah end of 75:20 to 40. Today's rota group recites 75:31 to 40.
questions.a: Answers on the teacher sheet, for example: ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ → al-'aajilah; ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ → at-taraaqee; سُدًى → sudaa.
The last word of an ayah; its rhyme and rhythm.
It ends in alif maqsurah, a natural madd; there is no tanween to replace.
A) sudaa (madd 'iwad, 2). Tanween fathah at a stop becomes a 2-count alif.

questions.q: Think again: Many ayah ends of Al-Qiyamah end in ة or alif. Why do ayah ends that sound alike help memorising?
questions.a: The rhyme (fasilah) gives a rhythm that helps the memory; it is part of the Qur'an's beauty.
